text: Have the producer run the boundary scan (`cargo test -p xtask --test policy`) on its changed files before it finishes, and fix any banned word it finds. Also make Athena run that same scan on the request text and on any files the request names before it admits the job, so that a banned word in the input is reworded first. The banned-word list in the brief was not enough by itself: in job 20261017-182453-a5sf the brief warned about 'operator' at lines 58-60, but docs/design/job-planning.md still failed on that word.
